title: 第七章 归途喋血从此慈悲不对敌第八章 演武碾压锋芒露骨不藏私
lines: 破晓晨光撕裂夜幕，洒遍黑风山脉的苍茫林海。
沈砚踏步下山，一身青布武服纤尘不染，身形行走在晨雾之间，步履平稳无波。可若是细细感知，便能察觉他周身气质已然彻底蜕变。
昨夜之前，他隐忍克制、留有余地，纵使遭人算计、屡陷绝境，依旧心存善意、手下留情。可一夜荒山历练，从三房重金雇凶的绝杀截杀，到古修洞府机缘加身，生死浮沉之间，他彻底勘破了武道人心的残酷本质。
温柔是弱者的墓志铭，杀伐是强者的立身骨。
他依旧守本心、存善意，却从此分清了善恶界限、敌我分寸。对无辜者，可留慈悲；对欲置他于死地的仇敌，从此再无半分留情。
佩戴在胸口的古朴静心玉佩微微发烫，温润气流缓缓滋养经脉、稳固心神，让他历经一夜厮杀掠夺的心境愈发澄澈冷冽，无半分戾气躁动，唯有极致的冷静与漠然。
淬体六重的浑厚气血内敛深藏，新习得的《流云碎月步》悄然运转，每一步落下都精准踩在气流节点之上，身形看似缓慢，实则瞬息数丈，轻松掠过山林乱石，归途速度远超寻常武者。
手中一卷《碎石诀》杀伐尽藏，身具中品顶尖身法加持，如今的沈砚，早已不是昨日那个仅凭根基稳压同阶的少年。同级之内，他可碾压无敌；越级对战，他可从容破局；身陷合围，他可杀伐突围。
昨夜那群溃逃的黑衣散修，成了压垮他最后一丝仁慈的稻草。
他本无意赶尽杀绝，落败之后已然放其生路，可人心贪婪恶毒，从来不懂知恩图报、适可而止。弱者的退让，只会被视作软弱；强者的留情，只会变成刺向自己的屠刀。
沈砚眼底掠过一抹冰冷寒芒，心底思绪彻底落定。
从今日起，沈砚的规矩改了。
不主动惹事，不妄造杀孽，可但凡敢出手袭杀、蓄意断他前路者，杀无赦。
慈悲只给善人，刀锋只斩恶人。
一路下山，山林雾气渐散，天光愈发透亮。往日晨起进山历练的武者、采药的散修陆续出没，三三两两结伴而行，欢声笑语，透着人间烟火。
沈砚沿途偶遇不少武者，众人皆被他沉稳冷冽的气场震慑，下意识避让退让，无人敢随意打量、招惹。历经生死杀伐的气质，远比刻意伪装的强势更具压迫感。
行至半山腰岔路口，前路豁然开朗，可沈砚的脚步却骤然一顿。
周身空气瞬间凝滞，一股隐晦阴冷的杀机，牢牢锁定了他的周身经脉，无孔不入，让人脊背发寒。
不是散修的浮躁贪利之杀，而是久经训练、隐忍蛰伏、只为夺命的死士杀机。
沈砚眸光微沉，漆黑眼底没有半分慌乱，只剩彻骨漠然。
他早有预料。
昨夜那群黑衣散修溃败而归，必然会向柳氏如实禀报战况。柳氏心思缜密、行事狠绝，知晓普通雇佣散修奈何不了他，便绝不会再浪费心力做无用试探，直接动用底牌死士，赶在他回城之前，伏杀于荒山之外。
借山林绝地杀人，借晨光混乱掩迹，一旦成功，他殒命荒山，只会被定性为历练不慎、葬身妖兽之口，与三房毫无干系。
好一招干净利落、阴毒无解的绝杀之局。
“躲了一夜，倒是有点耐心。”
沈砚低声自语，语气冰冷，无半分波澜。昨夜他浴血突破、探寻机缘，看似无人知晓，实则早已被暗处眼线死死盯住，全程监控。
下一秒，三道黑影骤然从两侧密林断崖窜出，身法迅捷、气息死寂，落地无声，呈三角合围之势，瞬间封死所有进退闪避路线。
三人皆是一身纯黑劲装，面覆玄铁面具，不露容貌，周身无半分多余气息，呼吸统一绵长，步伐规整划一，是镇北侯府专属培养的嫡系死士。
没有情绪，没有贪念，没有畏惧，唯命是从，只为夺命。
为首死士气息沉凝厚重，赫然是淬体八重修为，气血凝练、根基扎实，远超昨日七重散修。左右两名死士，皆是淬体七重巅峰，三人配合默契、攻防一体，是真正的绝杀阵容。
这般配置，若是放在昨日尚未突破的沈砚面前，绝对是九死一生的绝境。
可此刻，面对三名高阶死士的合围，沈砚站姿挺拔，神色漠然，心底没有半分惧意，只剩冰冷的杀伐决断。
柳氏为了杀他，不惜动用府中珍藏死士，可见已然彻底动了杀心，不死不休。
既然对方执意要他死，那他便以杀止杀，彻底清算。
“沈砚，奉命取你首级。”
为首死士声音沙哑冰冷，毫无情绪，抬手之间，一柄窄刃短刀出鞘，刀身暗沉无光，淬过隐毒，不见寒芒，却暗藏致命杀机。
另外两名死士同时拔刀，身形错位，瞬间形成合围刀阵，刀风内敛，杀机锁死，不给对手任何突围、周旋、求饶的余地。
content_en:
The dawn light tears through the night and spreads across the vast forest sea of ​​the Black Wind Mountains.
Shen Yan stepped down the mountain, wearing a clean green cloth military uniform, walking in the morning mist, his steps smooth and waveless. But if you feel it carefully, you can notice that his whole body's temperament has completely transformed.
Before last night, he had been forbearing and restrained, leaving room for leeway. Even though he was being plotted against and repeatedly put into desperate situations, he still had good intentions and showed mercy. But after a night of training in the barren mountains, from the killing and interception of Sanfang's heavily paid murderers, to the opportunity to join in the ancient cave, and between life and death, he completely discovered the cruel nature of the martial arts heart.
Gentleness is the epitaph of the weak, and killing is the foundation of the strong.
He still kept his true intentions and had good intentions, but he now understood the boundaries between good and evil, and the balance between friend and foe. Show mercy to the innocent; show no mercy to the enemies who want to kill them.
The simple jade pendant of meditation worn on his chest was slightly hot, and the warm air flow slowly nourished his meridians and stabilized his mind. His state of mind after a night of fighting and plundering became clearer and colder. There was no trace of violence and restlessness, only the ultimate calmness and indifference.
The rich Qi and blood of the sixth level of body tempering are restrained and deep. The newly acquired "Flowing Clouds and Shattering Moon Steps" are running quietly. Each step is accurately stepped on the nodes of the air flow. The body seems to be slow, but in fact it is several feet in an instant. It easily passes through the mountains, forests and rocks. The speed on the way back is far faster than that of ordinary warriors.
With a volume of "Gravel Technique" in his hand to hide all possible killings, and with the blessing of mid-level top-notch physical skills, Shen Yan is no longer the young man of yesterday who only relied on his basic skills to stabilize his level. Within the same level, he can crush invincible; in cross-level battles, he can calmly break the situation; when trapped in an encirclement, he can kill and break through.
The group of black-clothed cultivators who fled last night became the last straw that crushed his kindness.
He had no intention of killing them all, and he had already let them live after his defeat. However, his heart was greedy and vicious, and he never understood how to repay kindness and stop when enough is enough. The weak's concession will only be regarded as weakness; the strong's mercy will only become a butcher's knife stabbing him.
An icy cold light flashed across Shen Yan's eyes, and his thoughts completely settled in his heart.
From today on, Shen Yan's rules have changed.
Don't take the initiative to cause trouble, and don't commit murders rashly, but anyone who dares to attack and kill others and deliberately cuts off his path will be killed without mercy.
Mercy is only given to good people, and the edge of the sword only cuts down evil people.
All the way down the mountain, the fog in the mountains and forests gradually dispersed, and the sky became brighter and brighter. In the past, warriors who went into the mountains to practice in the morning and casual cultivators who collected herbs appeared one after another, walking in twos and threes, with laughter and laughter, and fireworks in the world.
Shen Yan met many warriors along the way. Everyone was intimidated by his calm and cold aura and subconsciously gave in. No one dared to look at or provoke him at will. The temperament that has experienced life and death is far more oppressive than the strength that is deliberately disguised.
When they reached a fork in the road halfway up the mountain, the road ahead suddenly became clear, but Shen Yan's steps suddenly stopped.
The air around him instantly stagnated, and a vague and cold murderous intent firmly locked onto the meridians of his body, penetrating pervasively and sending chills down one's spine.
It is not the impetuous and greedy killing of casual cultivators, but the murderous intention of a soldier who has been trained for a long time, is patient and dormant, and only wants to take his life.
Shen Yan's eyes darkened slightly, and there was no trace of panic in his dark eyes, only complete indifference.
He had expected it.
The group of black-clothed casual cultivators returned in defeat last night, and they would definitely report the truth about the battle to the Liu family. Mrs. Liu was thoughtful and ruthless in her actions. She knew that ordinary hired casual cultivators could not do anything to him, so she would never waste time on useless temptations. She directly used her trump card of dead soldiers to ambush him outside the barren mountains before he could return to the city.
He used the mountains and forests to kill people, and used the chaos of the morning light to cover up. Once he succeeded, his death in the barren mountains would only be characterized as being buried in the mouth of a monster due to careless experience, and had nothing to do with the third room.
What a clean, sinister, and invincible killing move.
"After hiding all night, I feel a little patient."
Shen Yan whispered to himself in a low voice, his tone was cold and without any waves. Last night, he made a bloody breakthrough and searched for opportunities. It seemed that no one knew about it, but in fact, he had been closely watched by the spy in the dark, and the whole process was monitored.
The next second, three black shadows suddenly sprang out from the dense forest cliffs on both sides. With swift movement and dead breath, they fell to the ground silently, forming a triangle of encirclement, instantly blocking all forward and backward evasion routes.
The three of them were all dressed in pure black, with black iron masks on their faces. Their faces were not exposed, and there was no extra breath in their bodies. Their breathing was uniform and long, and their steps were regular. They were the direct descendants specially trained by the Zhenbei Hou Mansion.
No emotions, no greed, no fear, just obey orders, just to take your life.
The aura of the leading dead soldier was thick and thick, and he was clearly at the eighth level of body tempering. His energy and blood were condensed and his foundation was solid, far exceeding the seventh level of casual cultivation yesterday. The two dead soldiers on the left and right are both at the peak of the seventh level of body tempering. The three of them cooperate with each other tacitly and integrate offense and defense. They are a true killer lineup.
Such a configuration, if placed in front of Shen Yan, who had not yet made a breakthrough yesterday, would definitely be a desperate situation.
But at this moment, facing the encirclement of three high-level dead soldiers, Shen Yan stood tall and straight, with an indifferent expression. There was no trace of fear in his heart, only a cold determination to kill.
In order to kill him, Mrs. Liu did not hesitate to use the dead men collected in the palace, which shows that she was completely determined to kill him and would not stop dying.
Since the other party insisted on his death, he would kill to stop the killing and make a complete settlement.
"Shen Yan, I have been ordered to take your head."
The voice of the leading dead soldier was hoarse and cold, without any emotion. As he raised his hand, a narrow-edged short sword was unsheathed. The blade was dull and dull. It had been tempered by the hidden poison, and there was no cold light, but it hid a fatal murderous intention.
The other two dead soldiers drew their swords at the same time, their bodies were misaligned, and an encircling sword formation was instantly formed. The sword style was restrained and the killing intent was locked, leaving no room for their opponents to break out, maneuver, or beg for mercy.
title_en: Chapter 7: Bloodshed on the way home, from now on, compassion and no enemy. Chapter 8: Performing martial arts to crush the edge and expose the naked body without hiding any secrets.
